encoding.decimal_values: Exact original decimal strings, including exponent notation; parse as rational decimals, not binary floats.
encoding.L_entries: Triples [row,column,exact_decimal_string], with 0-based indices. Omitted entries are exactly zero.
encoding.orientation_authority: Original Sage read_solution implementation, not the opposite orientation printed in its README.
encoding.inner_product: <A,B> = trace(A^T B), with all matrix entries included, not only the upper triangle.

basis.Q: Q_k^(n-1)(u,v,t) = ((1-u^2)*(1-v^2))^(k/2) * P_k^(n-1)((t-u*v)/sqrt((1-u^2)*(1-v^2))); evaluate its polynomial expansion at degenerate arguments.
basis.S: S_k is the average of Y_k over all six permutations of (u,v,t).

objective.formula: 1 + sum_{k=1}^16 a_k + B[0,0] + <J,F_0>, where J is the 17-by-17 all-ones matrix.

claim_status.published: Machado-de Oliveira Filho Table 1 lists the rigorously verified n=16,d=16 bound 7332.776399.
claim_status.newly_checked: Only source hash, exact decimal copying, block shapes/indices, L^T L orientation, and exact objective reconstruction were checked here.
claim_status.not_checked: No contact feasibility replay, SOS residual verification, positive-width certificate, perturbation calculation, or SDP solve. SOS blocks 34..40 are deliberately excluded.
